qualifier.description: 1983 E15-derived selected G1/G3/EG3 crude extracts; EG3 selected from G3. Historical proteins were not sequenced as current MG1655 accessions. EG oxidation: 250 mM EG, 0.33 mM NAD, 100 mM glycine pH 9.5, 25 C.

evidence.source_assertion: The study assayed EG oxidation in extracts of selected E15 derivatives, with 250 mM EG and NAD at alkaline pH. The selected strain history is distinct from the current reference strain.
evidence.source_locator: PDF pp. 134-136, Materials and Methods and Table 1

qualifier.description: 1983 E15-derived G1/G3/EG3 crude extracts: AldA assay 1 mM glycolaldehyde, 2.5 mM NAD, glycine pH 9.5, 25 C. Product chromatography separately used 3.5 mM glycolaldehyde and 5 mM NAD, 30 min at 37 C. Historical preparation is distinct from current MG1655.

evidence.source_assertion: The primary methods distinguish the spectrophotometric aldehyde-dehydrogenase assay from the separate glycolate product-identification incubation.
evidence.source_locator: PDF pp. 134-137, Enzyme assays and product-identification experiment

evidence.source_assertion: Methods describe BL21 expression of an N-terminal His-tagged recombinant AldA and nickel-chelate purification; the construct differs from the reference untagged protein.

qualifier.description: 2019 MG1655 aldA DNA cloned in pET28a/pVT-ALDA, produced in BL21(DE3) as N-terminal His-tagged protein and purified on cobalt resin; 1 mM IPTG, 16 C. Assay: 5 mM glycolaldehyde, 3 mM NAD, Tris pH 7.5, 10 mM MgCl2, 37 C.
